messages:
Marisol: Heads-up — our 3mo reserved GPU projection for hosted is diverging from actual demand. commit util down ~18% ytd, but hosted API requests are flat. thinking we should smooth the demand signal before we request upsells from finance. :thinking:
Jon: Can you paste the forecast vs actual? quick sanity check — is this region-specific? :eyes:
Marisol: Pulled a rough table from analytics: 
```
date,hosted_gpu_hours,committed_hours
2028-12-01,14240,16000
2028-12-08,14012,16000
2029-01-05,13890,16000
2029-02-02,14120,16000
```
Usage is consistently ~14k vs commit 16k. EU looks worse (13k vs 14.8k).
Priya: Do we know if cache/prefix hit rates improved? that can reduce GPU hours per request.
Marisol: Yes — Optimize rollout reduced avg seq by ~7% and cache TTL bump helped. So per-request cost lower. That explains the drop.
Kai: Ok — option list: 1) reassign some reserved to Dedicated customers (short-term), 2) renegotiate with cloud provider for convertible credits, 3) enable more burst-to-spot for hosted to avoid paying for unused committed capacity.
Jon: I like the smoothing idea + smaller operational moves. If we report raw weekly demand to finance they might push for bigger commits which we no longer need. Suggest we compute a 12-week EMA and present that instead.
Marisol: Agree. I'll run an EMA with alpha=0.2 and show both raw and smoothed to finance. Also want to model a worst-case where feature launches spike demand +20% — need runway.
infra-bot: [capacity-check] reserved_utilization=0.82 region=us-west1 snapshot=1876543200
Priya: For the runway model, add a migration plan to reassign EU reserved to NA within 48h if utilization delta > 10%. Ops playbook exists.
Kai: Action items: Marisol to produce smoothed forecast + 3 scenarios (baseline, +20% spike, -10% drift) by EOD Friday. Jon to scope short-term cross-region transfer feasibility with cloud ops. Priya to check if we can delay a minor scheduled fleet expansion next quarter.
Marisol: Adding a quick query I used to build the table so folks can reproduce: 
```
-- hosted_gpu_hours per week
SELECT date_trunc('week', ts) as wk, sum(gpu_hours) as hosted_gpu_hours
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE product = 'hosted-api' AND env = 'prod'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 12;
```
Jon: Nice — can we also surface token-level throughput? finance cares about cost-per-token when debating commit size.
Marisol: Will include tokens/hour and cost-per-gpu-hour in the deck.
Priya: Quick FYI — marketplace reseller option has a 4–6 week lead time to spin up. Not ideal if we need fast reallocation.
Kai: Cool. If anyone sees utilization cross below 0.75 for two consecutive weeks, tag #infra-oncall and we'll run the transfer. :white_check_mark:
